verdict: The 120-payload replay arithmetic is independently reproducible, but C counts adjacent windows, not independent accumulation contexts. The result is admissible only as an ideal bank-disjoint window-batch replay opportunity until token ownership, finite fill, tagged responses, concurrent Acc24 ports, VCS and matched DC are implemented.

independent_method.bit_lut: independently generated by integer shifts for all 256 byte values
independent_method.arrival_order: nonzero 96-bit descriptors compressed per token, partitioned into stage depth windows, then batched without reordering and flushed at each FC2 record boundary

window_context_semantic_audit.finding: C is a window-batch depth. Adjacent windows are not guaranteed to own distinct token accumulators.
window_context_semantic_audit.correctness_requirement: Windows from the same token must share one token-owned Acc24 and reduce all same-cycle bank contributions once. If each window instead owns an independent accumulator, partial-result merge storage, arithmetic and cycles must be added.
window_context_semantic_audit.cross_token_independence: FC2 token arithmetic is independent within one frozen FC2 call, but later BN2, residual, ATLIF ordering and complete-FC2 completion are outside this model.

resource_and_port_audit.weight_banks: The formula obeys one read per physical bank per cycle in the ideal scheduler.
resource_and_port_audit.context_updates: To retain the ideal schedule, a cycle may return banks tagged for multiple tokens. The implementation must route and reduce those responses into every active token context in that cycle; one shared Acc24 read-modify-write port would serialize the gain away.
resource_and_port_audit.acc24_numeric_width: For binary FC2 inputs, signed INT8 weights and maximum input width 3072, the absolute bound is 3072*128=393216, which fits signed 20 bits. Acc24 is width-safe for the pure FC2 sum, but ownership and porting are unproved.
resource_and_port_audit.response_identity: ceil(log2(C)) context bits alone are insufficient when slots can be reused across delayed responses or reset. A valid generation/epoch or a proven flush-ack quarantine is required.
resource_and_port_audit.descriptor_fill: The replay total assumes resident batches. It excludes 18,869,376 nonzero descriptor accepts and 36,480,000 raw 96-bit scan beats, buffer occupancy, fill/drain conflicts and producer backpressure.
resource_and_port_audit.optimistic_wall: Adding M187's 18,209,963-cycle overhead unchanged is not an admitted wall model because co-issue changes buffer occupancy, context completion and overlap.

required_functional_evidence: VCS with finite descriptor arrival, at least same-token and cross-token adjacent windows, all partial-batch tails, result stalls and request/response stalls
at most one accepted read per bank per cycle and no dropped, duplicated or cross-tagged source
exact 96-lane signed Acc24 conservation with same-token windows sharing one accumulator
response slot generation or flush-ack quarantine covering reset and delayed stale responses
explicit context-state read/write implementation, not an excluded environment assumption
required_performance_evidence: matched complete-island C1 and C2 cycle counts with finite fill and weight-response latency
3.000 ns VCS/DC admission with precommitted timing, area and logic-depth gates
throughput-per-area greater than C1 after all context routing/state within the chosen macro boundary

replay_only_area_density_threshold_again.warning: This is only a replay-kernel break-even screen, not a physical admission threshold. Actual finite-cycle throughput must replace it.

c2_first_rtl_gate.nonadmission: The current 1.114620273x is not an RTL, FC2, wall, physical or system speedup.

c4_upper_bound_gate.reason: C4 improves replay cycles only 1.059729023x over C2, while 91.187949% of its batches contain fewer than four distinct tokens.
c4_upper_bound_gate.promotion_gate: C4 must beat an admitted C2 implementation in finite-cycle throughput per area and energy after four-window buffering, actual distinct-token mapping, context storage/ports and tagged bank routing.

forbidden: treating W as the number of distinct token contexts
using optimistic_wall fields as measured or admitted wall cycles
RTL-measured, physical, energy, FPS, PPA or headline claims

p0: Rename C to W-window batch depth or recompute a true distinct-token-context DSE. Preserve token IDs and require same-token windows to share Acc24; otherwise charge partial-result merges.
Before promoting C2, implement finite fill, tagged weight responses, simultaneous token-owned Acc24 updates and exact VCS conservation, then compare matched 3 ns area and finite cycles against C1.
p1: Add an arrival-timed queue model with descriptor producer bandwidth, bounded window/context occupancy and result backpressure; remove the unchanged-overhead optimistic wall proxy from performance comparisons.
Carry context slot generation/epoch or flush-ack quarantine so delayed pre-reset responses cannot alias a reused context.
Use dynamic token-aware window admission; C4 statically provisions four contexts for batches that contain four tokens only 8.812051% of the time.
Report per-stage finite-cycle gains because C2 replay gain ranges from 1.191227x at stage 0 to only 1.090428x at stage 3.
